description: In pkix-chain-simple/src/lib.rs, the check_algorithm function comment says 'returns Error::Path(SignatureInvalid) for that case' when referring to the RFC 5280 §4.1.1.2 outer/inner OID consistency check. The actual error returned by check_oid_consistency (in validate_path) is Error::MalformedCertificate { index }, not Error::SignatureInvalid. A maintainer reading this comment will look for the wrong error variant when debugging OID-mismatch failures.
title: check_algorithm comment wrong error type: says SignatureInvalid, actual is MalformedCertificate
